items.title: Can AI Generate Good Designs from Raw User Data?
items.excerpt: In an NN/g study across two design tasks, AI-generated interfaces were better when the model received synthesized research findings and recommendations rather than raw user comments alone.
items.rationale: Primary NN/g study with a directly usable rule: feed AI synthesized research, not raw comments — changes how designers prompt tomorrow.

items.title: Envato's 2nd Annual AI Report Finds Adoption Has Outrun the Rules
items.excerpt: Envato's survey of 1,033 creatives finds 58% use AI daily, 53% have put it on client work without telling the client, and most in-house team creatives have no written AI policy.
items.rationale: Fresh survey data on creatives' AI use and undisclosed client work; assigned to design (not movies) by the run brief.

items.title: 퓨저, 문장으로 만드는 맞춤형 편집 도구 공개 (Fuser Tool Node)
items.excerpt: Fuser's 'Tool Node' lets users describe an editing tool in a sentence; the AI designs sliders and switches, writes and tests the tool and places it on the canvas, where it can be chained with other nodes and shared via a team library.
items.rationale: Concrete new feature: designers generate their own canvas editing tools from a sentence and share them team-wide.

items.title: Gestalt beat Claude Fable 5.2 in 78% of blind design votes
items.excerpt: A stealth model called Gestalt took first place on Contra Labs and BenchFlow's Frontier Design Benchmark at 1,931 Elo, a 218-point lead; professional designers picked it over Claude Fable 5.2 in 78% of blind head-to-head votes.
items.rationale: New design-specific benchmark result judged by professional designers; signals which model to watch for UI generation (off-list outlet, only coverage).

items.title: Everyone knows sparkles mean AI. Use them to make design audits easier
items.excerpt: How to decipher your PM's AI-generated mockup without losing hours: a practical method for auditing AI-produced prototypes using the sparkle convention as a marker.
items.rationale: Practical audit method for AI-generated mockups from PMs — immediately usable in design reviews.
